title: Score
description: A numerical or ordinal evaluation derived from measures against a declared scale (CR-5 §11). A score is not intrinsically a maturity level; the framework defines the transformation. Derivation from measures is expressed via the dea:derives-from relationship (CR-3: no relationship state on entities).

id.description: Stable OpenDEA identifier (CR-3Q). Type prefix: dea:score-

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

scale_ref.description: Reference to the declared Scale (A004: scores use a declared scale).

relationships.description: Derived convenience view (CR-1/CR-3): canonical relationship instances are authoritative.
